name: mcp-rag
description: MCP RAG monorepo — Node.js backend + Angular frontend

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:be" "npm run start:fe" "npm run start:mcp"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix be install && npm --prefix fe install && npm --prefix mcp install
scripts.build: npm run build:be && npm run build:fe && npm run build:mcp
scripts.test: concurrently "npm run test:be" "npm run test:fe" "npm run test:mcp"
